# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class EquityOpeningRangeBreakoutAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2024, 9, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)

        # automatic_indicator_warm_up only supports automatic indicators, not manual indicators.
        self.settings.automatic_indicator_warm_up = True

        self._spy = self.add_equity("SPY")
        self._ob = self.ob(self._spy, 10, Resolution.MINUTE)
        # Alternatively, use a manual indicator.
        # self._ob = OpeningRangeBreakout(10)
        # self.warm_up_indicator(self._spy, self._ob, Resolution.MINUTE)
        # self.register_indicator(self._spy, self._ob, Resolution.MINUTE)

        self._has_traded_today = False

        self.schedule.on(
            self.date_rules.every_day(self._spy),
            self.time_rules.after_market_open(self._spy, 1),
            self._rebalance
        )

    def _rebalance(self) -> None:
        if self._has_traded_today:
            return

        bar = self._ob.current
        if not bar:
            return

        price = self._spy.price
        high = bar.high
        low = bar.low

        if not self._spy.holdings.invested and price > high:
            self.set_holdings(self._spy, 1)
            self._has_traded_today = True
        elif not self._spy.holdings.invested and price < low:
            self.set_holdings(self._spy, -1)
            self._has_traded_today = True
